response.text: Your goal is moving off Zapier to self-hosted n8n by rebuilding 6 workflows. To achieve this, I will rebuild each one in n8n, test it with you, and hand over a short doc. First, I will audit the 6 existing Zapier workflows including the form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, Stripe payment to email receipt, and three small Gmail filters on your Zapier account. Next, I will rebuild the form to Google Sheets and Sheets to Slack alerts workflows in your self-hosted n8n instance. I did nearly this for a lead intake client: lead entry dropped from about 2 hours a week to under 10 minutes. Which specific custom code actions are used inside your current Zapier steps?
